knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Section 2 Definitions: the standard describes a knowledgeable person by the know-how needed to run a public pool within the regulations.
Section 1 and the foreword describe the public-pool scope under the regulations. Applicability to private pools must be checked before use.
Section 3 Management: while the facility is open, the owner and operator both answer for water quality under the regulations.

practicalCriteria: For a supplied site scenario, records pool type, public or private status and state on the site sheet without prompting.
For a supplied site with no named operator, escalates the gap to the operator in writing and does not start work on the water.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed site record sheet for a supplied scenario
Written escalation note, observed or reviewed by the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: Operator for a public pool cannot be identified: do not start work on the water; escalate.
Public or private status is unclear: stop and confirm before any chemical or water work.
